notes: Route: the site's own WordPress RSS feed, paged. https://globalnews.ca/feed/?paged=N gives 10 items per page newest-first with a <pubDate> per item, which is a date the site itself states. Measured density ~50 items/day (paged=100 lands on 2026-10-07, paged=400 on 2026-08-07), so 170 pages covered 2026-09-25..2026-10-25 completely: 1528 unique URLs, 31 of 31 days filled, 39 URLs on 2026-09-30, 24 on 2026-10-10, 63 on 2026-10-20. Listed date = <pubDate> converted to America/Toronto (the calendar day the article page shows). Only /news/<id>/ article URLs kept; the recurring 'watch ...' live-player pages are dropped because their pubDate is bumped daily. Closed routes, all tested: robots.txt DISALLOWS /wp-json/ so the WP REST trick used on nationalpost.com/aptnnews.ca is unavailable here (not attempted); /sitemap.xml is an empty Jetpack index (200, 253 bytes, 'Jetpack_Sitemap_Buffer_Empty'); /news-sitemap.xml is a Google News urlset with only ~48h of items (26 items on 10-24, 17 on 10-25 - far short of a month); /videos/sitemap/ is videos only; /sitemap.xml?yyyy=2026&mm=10&dd=20, /sitemap_index.xml, /wp-sitemap.xml, /sitemap-index.xml and /archives/2026/10/20/ all 404; https://globalnews.ca/?feed=rss2&year=2026&monthnum=10&day=20 and '&posts_per_page=100' are silently ignored (page 1 returned unchanged), so paging is the only knob. Wayback CDX for globalnews.ca/news/* returned status 0 (timeout) twice and was not used as a top-up. Verification: 4 sample articles re-fetched (one each from 09-30, 10-05, 10-10, 10-20), all HTTP 200 with 11.6k-18.1k characters of text and JSON-LD datePublished exactly equal to the listed date. Runtime 150 s, ~175 requests, no 429/503. Section feeds are wired in as a top-up but never fire: they only run if one of the three sampled days is under 15, and the main feed alone leaves every day at 11 or more. The last day, 2026-10-25, has 11 because the feed was walked while that day was still in progress.
